attention1.ptxt: If you do not select a suitable route and take proper precautions when performing a road test, an accident can occur.

item.ptxt: Select a level road with no traffic to minimize the risk of accident.
Perform the road test with 2 persons, a driver and a tester.

attention4.ptxt: If TCM learning value initialization is not performed after one of the following operations has been performed, there is a possibility that the vehicle will not be able to move.
Perform TCM learning value initialization whenever one of the following operations has been performed:

item.ptxt: Valve body assembly is removed or replaced.
A/T assembly is disassembled or replaced.
Limit the driving speed permissible in road conditions and regulations.
If TCM learning value initialization is not completed, excessive shift shock could be felt.

s1.ptxt: Drive vehicle so that ATF temperature reaches normal operating temperature (65 to 110 °C (149 to 230 °F)).

attention3.ptxt: Engine coolant temperature rises when racing engine at P or N range. But ATF temperature does not rise at P or N range.
Drive vehicle to raise ATF temperature.

s1.ptxt: Perform garage shift learning as follows:

s2.ptxt: Stop vehicle with engine running and place it horizontally.
Keep engine idling, depress brake pedal fully and shift select lever to N range for 3 seconds.
Shift select lever to D range for 3 seconds.
Shift select lever to N range for 3 seconds, and then shift select lever to R range for 3 seconds.

s1.ptxt: Perform gear shift control learning as follows:

s2.ptxt: Accelerate vehicle up to practicable maximum speed in D range with accelerator pedal depressed 25 – 35%.

item.ptxt: Limit the driving speed permissible in road conditions and regulations.
Insufficient driving speed may cause remaining shift shock. However, the shock will be solved by self-learning during driving after that.

s2.ptxt: Decelerate vehicle with engine brake releasing accelerator pedal and stop vehicle.
